title: CUDA kernel regression in flash attention after 0.4.2
body:
Throughput dropped from 1.9 TFLOP/s to 1.1 TFLOP/s on an RTX 4090.
Bisected to the tile-size change in `attn_fwd`. `nsys` shows 2x the global loads.

title: Memory leak in the allocator pool on repeated model reload
body: RSS grows by ~40 MB per load/unload cycle. valgrind blames `pool_grow()`.

title: Build fails with GCC 15 on Linux: -Werror=calloc-transposed-args
body: GCC 15 promoted this to an error. One-line fix, patch attached.
